scope: Agent access on the real server (Hostinger, Ubuntu 26.04) after the signed v0.5.2 was installed through the release channel, from a workstation through the public address behind Cloudflare, against the one existing environment (no application data). A one-day access token for the installation owner was minted in the server's token store by a one-off script (the owner's console password is lost), used, then revoked. Covers the hosted MCP endpoint, the official Supabase MCP server over stdio pointed at /v1, the Supabase CLI through a profile, and Claude Code as a real client. Not a load test. Earlier runs on 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 found two faults, fixed in 0.5.1 and 0.5.2: an Edge Function answer marked gzip over an uncompressed body, and a new table invisible to REST until PostgREST reloaded.
